content: For BswMSwitchAckNotification , if the referenced BswM- SwitchPort is configured with BswMSchMModeDeclarationGroupRef : This spec- ifies a BswModeSwitchedAckEvent, which the BswM shall create in its BSWMD. The BswM shall create an associated runnable; the C definition of this runnable/schedula- ble entity shall arbitrate the BswModeSwitchedAckEvent.
